title: Debate-to-Detect: Reformulating Misinformation Detection as a Real-World Debate with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reversing the initial speaking order of the Affirmative and Negative sides to evaluate if the model favors the first speaker, measuring the absolute difference in judgement consistency.

Replacing the conceptually charged side labels 'Affirmative' and 'Negative' with neutral terms 'Supporter' and 'Skeptic' to measure the model's susceptibility to positive or negative label connotations.
